import.toastErrorDescription: The file could not be processed. Please check it and try again.

guide.title: Import units from a spreadsheet
guide.description: One row per unit, in an .xlsx or .csv file. Column names can be in English, Russian or Kyrgyz; blocks, entrances and floors that don't exist yet are created.

block.label: Block
block.hint: Block or building name, e.g. A

type.label: Type
type.hint: Apartment, commercial, parking or storage (apartment if empty)

reimport.title: Importing the same project again
reimport.body: Units already in the project (same block and number) aren't created twice. A new price is taken for available units only; reserved, sold and withdrawn units keep theirs, and you'll see which.
reimport.needsApproval: New prices are sent for approval first, like editing a price by hand.
reimport.noEditPrice: You can't change prices, so rows with a new price are listed as problems.

fileErrors.title: The file's columns weren't recognised
fileErrors.unrecognised: None of its columns match. The file has: {{found}}. Rename them as in the table below, or start from the sample file.
fileErrors.missing: These columns are missing: {{missing}}. Add them, named as in the table below.

result.kept: Prices kept, unit not on sale: {{count}}
result.requestedHint: The new prices apply once someone who approves prices accepts them.

kept.title: Prices kept
kept.hint: These units are reserved, sold or withdrawn, so a deal or a decision depends on their price. Change it on the unit itself if you need to.

rowErrors.floorInvalid: Floor must be a whole number
rowErrors.areaInvalid: Area must be a number above zero
rowErrors.priceInvalid: Price must be a number above zero
rowErrors.typeInvalid: Unknown type "{{value}}": use apartment, commercial, parking or storage
rowErrors.roomsInvalid: Rooms must be a whole number
rowErrors.priceNotAllowed: Unit {{number}} exists and its price differs, but you can't change prices
rowErrors.duplicateInFile: Unit {{number}} in block {{block}} is already on row {{row}}
rowErrors.rowFailed: This row couldn't be saved; check it and try again

form.priceLocked: Only roles allowed to change prices can edit this.
form.priceNeedsApproval: A new price goes to the Company Admin for approval. Until then the unit keeps its current price.

duplicate.title: Duplicate unit?
